S6:22.text: Who hauing bid a great number of his freinds to the feaſt, made the mariage.

S6:23.text: And at night he brought in Lia his daughter to him,24.

S6:31.text: And our Lord ſeeing that he deſpiſed Lia, opened her womb, her ſiſter remaining barren.

S6:32.text: Who conceaued and bare a ſonne, and called his name Ruben, ſaying Our Lord ſaw mine affliction: now my husband will loue me.

S6:33.text: And againe she conceived and bare a ſonne, and ſaid: For becauſe our Lord heard that I was contemned, he hath giuen this alſo to me: and she called his name Simeon.

S6:34.text: And she conceaued the third time, and bare another ſonne and ſaid Now alſo my huſband wil be ioyned to me for becauſe I haue borne him three ſonnes: and therfore she called his name. Leui.
